title: DayOne plans 200MW data center in Japan’s Imari City
key_facts: DayOne, a Singapore-headquartered digital infrastructure platform, and Imari City announced a 200 MW data center campus in Saga Prefecture, Japan.
Site: 133,000 square metres in the Imari East Industrial Park; 160 MW of secured powered land.
First phase targeted to operate in 2030; built in phases.
About 60 to 80 full-time jobs once operating.
CEO Jamie Khoo quoted on Kyushu's potential; the campus extends DayOne's Japan platform beyond Tokyo.
quote_evidence: DayOne, a Singapore-headquartered global digital infrastructure platform, and Imari City last week announced plans to develop a new data center campus at Imari City, Saga Prefecture, Japan, with 200MW of grid power.
why_it_matters_hint: A new Japanese regional site shows data center building outside Tokyo.
